name: 4-FPP
summary: A piperazine derivative that has been reported to have mild pyschedelic effects and empathogenic qualities. It has been sold in many branded legal highs.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: It has also been shown to inhibit the reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine, and to possibly induce their release. Metabolic studies have shown pFPP to be an inhibitor of various Cytochrome P450 enzymes in the liver which may contribute to its side-effect profile.

uses.text: It has been sold as an ingredient in legal recreational drugs known as "Party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Piperazine party drugs of its kind, such as BZP, can cause nausea, headache, anxiety, insomnia, a racing heart and a hangover-like feeling the next day. Seizures have been reported with BZP.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的哌嗪類派對藥物（例如BZP）可能引起噁心、頭痛、焦慮、失眠、心跳急促，以及隔天類似宿醉的不適。BZP曾有引起癲癇發作的報告。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的哌嗪类派对药物（例如BZP）可能引起恶心、头痛、焦虑、失眠、心跳急促，以及隔天类似宿醉的不适。BZP曾有引起癫痫发作的报告。

fact.en: Piperazine, the ring at the heart of this drug, was first used in medicine in the 1950s to treat worm infections. Decades later, piperazine derivatives such as BZP became the main ingredients of legal party pills in New Zealand.
fact.zh: 這種藥物核心的哌嗪環，最早在1950年代被用於醫學上治療寄生蟲感染。數十年後，BZP等哌嗪衍生物成為紐西蘭合法「派對藥丸」的主要成分。
fact.zhHans: 这种药物内核的哌嗪环，最早在1950年代被用于医学上治疗寄生虫感染。数十年后，BZP等哌嗪衍生物成为新西兰合法「派对药丸」的主要成分。
